title: Midterm room changed to HBK 0302
body: The midterm on Tuesday is now in Hornbake 0302, not our usual room. Same time. Bring a pencil and your student ID.

title: Project 2 rubric posted
body: The rubric for Project 2 is on Canvas. Read it before Friday's studio. Office hours move to Thursday 3 to 5pm this week.

title: Fall doubles social
body: Mixed doubles round robin. All levels welcome. Partners are assigned on arrival. Balls provided; bring your own racquet and water.

title: Fall court schedule
body: We hit Tuesdays and Thursdays from 7 to 9pm on Courts 3 to 6 at Campus Rec. Bring your own racquet; balls are provided.

title: Portfolio review night
body: Bring two or three case studies. Designers from DC agencies will give one-on-one feedback in 15-minute slots.

title: Final project checkpoint due Friday
body: Submit your checkpoint report on ELMS by Friday at 11:59pm. Include your GitHub repository and published site URL.

title: JavaScript debugging lab
body: Optional lab on using the browser console and breakpoints. Bring your laptop and your current project.

title: Hack night: build a web app in 3 hours
body: Pizza, mentors and a starter template. Teams of up to four. No experience needed.

title: Turkey Trot carpool sign-up
body: We are carpooling to the Thanksgiving 5K. Add your name to the sheet in GroupMe by Sunday if you need a ride.

title: Quest 3 open lab
body: Try the lab's headsets and see student projects. Sign the equipment waiver at the door.

title: Spring cohort applications open
body: Applications for the spring cohort close December 5. Solo founders and teams are welcome to apply.

title: Mentorship mixer
body: Meet mentors from local tech companies. Light food provided. Business casual.
location: Stamp Student Union, Prince George's Room

title: Studio critique
body: Bring printed copies of your Project 2 prototype for peer critique.

title: Wall closed this weekend
body: The Eppley wall is closed Saturday and Sunday for route setting. Sessions resume Monday.

title: This week's reading: think-aloud protocols
body: We are discussing chapter 6 of Observing the User Experience on Wednesday. Come with one question.
